summary: This is a routine Form 6-K disclosure by Pearson plc of PDMR share transactions. A president sold 75,308 ordinary shares at prices between 12.08 and 12.195 GBP per share, totaling 915,173.81 GBP, executed on the London Stock Exchange on 26-27 August 2026. No corporate action, no recommendation, no advisors, no structural terms. This is a standard insider trading notification, not a special situation.
